description: This file defines ANGLE-specific enums and functions for handling OpenGL texture types, texture targets, and related conversions, as well as EGL error handling and texture target conversions for EGL.

methods.name: TextureTargetToType
methods.description: Converts a TextureTarget enum to a TextureType enum.

methods.name: IsCubeMapFaceTarget
methods.description: Checks if a TextureTarget is a cube map face.

methods.name: NonCubeTextureTypeToTarget
methods.description: Converts a TextureType to a TextureTarget, excluding cube maps.

methods.name: CubeFaceIndexToTextureTarget
methods.description: Converts a face index (0-5) to a cube map TextureTarget.

methods.name: CubeMapTextureTargetToFaceIndex
methods.description: Converts a cube map TextureTarget to a face index.

methods.name: SamplerTypeToTextureType
methods.description: Maps a GLenum sampler type to a TextureType.

methods.name: IsMultisampled
methods.description: Checks if a TextureType is multisampled.

methods.name: IsArrayTextureType
methods.description: Checks if a TextureType is an array texture.

methods.name: ErrorCodeToMessageType
methods.description: Converts an EGL error code to a MessageType.

methods.name: EGLCubeMapTargetToCubeMapTarget
methods.description: Converts an EGL cube map target to a gl::TextureTarget.

methods.name: EGLImageTargetToTextureTarget
methods.description: Converts an EGL image target to a gl::TextureTarget.

methods.name: EGLTextureTargetToTextureType
methods.description: Converts an EGL texture target to a gl::TextureType.
